buildCommand: S=$(npx prisma migrate diff --from-url "$DATABASE_URL" --to-schema-datamodel prisma/schema.prisma --script 2>/dev/null); echo "DIFF_ADD_COLUMNS=$(printf '%s' "$S" | grep -c 'ADD COLUMN')"; echo "DIFF_CREATE_TABLES=$(printf '%s' "$S" | grep -c 'CREATE TABLE')"; echo "DIFF_DROP_COLUMNS=$(printf '%s' "$S" | grep -c 'DROP COLUMN')"; echo "DIFF_DROP_TABLES=$(printf '%s' "$S" | grep -c 'DROP TABLE')"; echo "DIFF_DROP_CONSTRAINTS=$(printf '%s' "$S" | grep -c 'DROP CONSTRAINT')"; printf '%s' "$S" | grep -E '^ALTER TABLE .* (ADD|DROP) COLUMN|^CREATE TABLE' | head -12; npm run build
